title: Capitalisation indexes by UTF-16 code unit, so words starting with astral letters are not capitalised
property: the first letter of each word in pascalSnakeCase output is uppercase when the letter has an uppercase form
evidence: split() uses \p{L} with the u flag, so astral letters count as word letters, but capitalCaseTransformFactory does upper(word[0]) / word.slice(1), which cuts a surrogate pair in half; toUpperCase of a lone high surrogate is a no-op. Doc: 'Convert a string to pascal snake case (Foo_Bar)'.
